result.plainSummary: The audit accounts for every earlier requirement and clearly preserves the gaps that still need proof.
result.summary: Independent T039 review of exhaustive W001–W008 audit, validator, corrected syntax preload/language selection and MCP status evidence. Ran five audit tests including two independently authored killers; contradictory summary counts originally passed, then the unchanged killer passed after summary totals and scope were validated. Ran repository validator against final report: all 51 criteria match current text and mappings with readable confined source references. Reviewed all criterion judgments and final corrected totals: 17 mapped, 29 gaps, 5 superseded; W004 typography remains a gap rather than invented supersession. Source citations now cover previously uncited UI judgments; mappings remain separate from pass. Read saved MCP log showing 11 tests passed and explicit limits on host installation, publication and agent recovery. UI preload passes explicit TypeScript/JavaScript language and preserves code rendering on loading failure, with no execution from reads. Root reports UI tests/typecheck and exact SL027 browser highlighting verified. Final explicit claim execution is a separate closure prerequisite.
killersCited: packages/ui/lib/completed-audit.break.test.mjs: audit cannot relabel another workstream or erase a mapped requirement
packages/ui/lib/completed-audit.break.test.mjs: audit summary counts and scope must agree with its inspected inventory
packages/ui/lib/completed-audit.test.mjs: rejects missing, duplicate, rewritten and falsely mapped audit entries
residualRisks: Audit completeness does not prove every historical feature passes: 29 gaps and 5 superseded requirements remain explicit.
Recorded evidence observations are dated snapshots; final live verification establishes later freshness.
Syntax highlighting depends on lazy-loaded renderer assets; the UI reports loading/failure separately from test evidence.
